column1: # Competing words for the same meaning, one row per word:
# concept  the meaning, named by today's word
# role     old       the Ottoman (Arabic or Persian) word
#          proposal  the 1935 TDK guide's proposal, when it differs from today's word
# theme    meclis (parliamentary procedure), devlet (state and politics), genel (everyday
#          words), eğitim (education and science); used to group and colour the charts
# These are well-known pairs, which overstates how often the Language Reform succeeded
# (pairs that failed are less famous). The real sample comes from the 1935 guide (see
# README); this list is for building and testing the analysis. Known ambiguities, to
# check with `evo kwic`: bakan is also "looking", vekil now mostly "deputy" (Başkan
# Vekili), örneğin is "for example", özel is also a surname, barış and savaş are names.
# örgüt after 1990 is mostly "terör örgütü" (a change of meaning, not only of word);
# değer is also the verb form "it is worth".
# Feminine and plural forms (umumiye, hudut as plural of had) are counted through the
# lexicon; do not list them as separate words, or their uses would be counted twice.
# Added 2026-10-14, checked against the counts: pairs whose forms collide with common
# words were left out (il: ile; gelir, gider: verbs; batı, dil, çalışma, tahsil).
